mapper.select: select patient_id from base_patient where concat(IFNULL(name,''),IFNULL(pinyin_name,''),IFNULL(mobile,'')) like concat(concat('%',#{combination}),'%')

SELECT patient_id patientId, first_visit_date firstVisitDate, first_visit_doctors firstVisitDoctors, first_visit_outpatient firstVisitOutpatient, cumulative_consumption cumulativeConsumption, last_visit_date lastVisitDate, last_visit_doctors lastVisitDoctors, last_visit_outpatient lastVisitOutpatient, total_arrears totalArrears, number_of_visits numberOfVisits FROM base_patient WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
